paragraphs: I'm Kavindu Kokila, a full-stack software engineer and entrepreneur based in Sri Lanka with over 5 years of experience in building scalable web applications, mobile solutions, and enterprise systems. As Co-Founder and Tech Lead at Talnova, I specialize in SaaS HR Tech innovations, including AI-powered recruitment tools and cloud-native architectures.

Explore my professional portfolio or devfolio for case studies on full-stack development, AI projects, and enterprise solutions. For collaborations in full-stack development, AI-driven apps, or HR tech, let's connect!
